# RydeTime Auto

RydeTime Auto is an independent used car dealership located at 1913 Holland Road, Suffolk, VA 23434.

## About
Family-operated used car dealership serving Suffolk, Virginia Beach, Chesapeake, Norfolk, Portsmouth, and the Hampton Roads area of Virginia. No-pressure, honest used car shopping with AI-powered search and assistance.

## Services
- Used vehicle sales
- Financing for all credit situations including first-time buyers and credit rebuilding
- Trade-in appraisals
- Vehicle hold deposits
- AI-powered vehicle matching and concierge

## Vehicle History
Carfax reports available on many vehicles. One-owner, accident-free, and service record badges only displayed when officially confirmed by Carfax or DealerCenter data.

## Positioning
Honest used car dealership. Vehicles are pre-owned and presented accurately. Customers encouraged to review Carfax, inspect vehicles, and test drive before purchase.
